vertebrae.cache.s3_store
========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.cache.s3_store

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   S3-backed artifact store.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.cache.s3_store.S3ArtifactStore


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: S3ArtifactStore(bucket, prefix = '', endpoint_url = None, profile_name = None, region_name = None)

   Store artifacts in S3-compatible object storage.

   :param bucket: S3 bucket name.
   :param prefix: Optional object key prefix.
   :param endpoint_url: Optional S3-compatible endpoint URL.
   :param profile_name: Optional boto3 profile name.
   :param region_name: Optional AWS region name.


   .. py:method:: from_uri(uri, **options)
      :classmethod:


      Build an S3 store from a `s3://bucket/prefix` URI.



   .. py:method:: config()

      Return a serializable config for reconstructing this store.



   .. py:method:: exists(key)

      Return whether an embedding artifact exists for `key`.



   .. py:method:: put_array(key, arr)

      Store a dense or sparse embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: put_array_batches(key, batches, n_samples, require_complete = True)

      Store embeddings from deterministic batches.



   .. py:method:: get_array(key)

      Load a dense or sparse embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: put_labels(key, labels)

      Store labels as JSON.



   .. py:method:: get_labels(key)

      Load labels from JSON.



   .. py:method:: put_json(key, obj)

      Store JSON metadata for an artifact key.



   .. py:method:: get_json(key)

      Load JSON metadata for an artifact key.
